timeline.tweet: My crippling anxiety has gotten so much better that I'm performing in a play for the first time in about eight years.

I was diagnosed with severe depression 20 yrs ago. I couldn't get out of bed, sobbed myself to sleep every night, wanted a divorce, and wanted to just go to sleep and wake up when it was all over. Therapy and meds saved my life. *Please* don't give up.❤ #BeBraveShareYourStory

After years of struggling with severe anxiety that kept me pretty much homebound, I was in a play for the first time in eight years.

I'm always afraid I'm going to get yelled at. I've never taken a bus or a train because I don't know where the money goes and I'm afraid the driver will yell at me. I know where the fear comes from, but the thought of doing it fills me with anxiety about getting yelled at.
My anxiety tells me that I don't belong somewhere, and that everyone else there thinks so, too.
The Wonders hear their song on the radio for the first time. This scene gives me chills every time I watch it. #OneHitWonder #ThatThingYouDo
